actions.action: Check the pH of water and runoff
If using strong nutrients, flush with plain pH-adjusted water and reduce feed strength
Let the top inch of soil dry out before watering again
Check that the light isn't too close
Check temperature and humidity are in range
Note any recent feeding, watering or environmental changes
Report medium, feeding schedule, pH readings, watering frequency and send a close-up of a yellowing leaf

reason: The answer names nutrient deficiency as the likely cause but lists it alongside lockout, overfeeding and overwatering, and never tells the owner to simply feed. Its conditional flushing advice is safeguarded, so it is not graded harmful.
